ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 80% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels on the interior surfaces and 20% low-intensity black pixels localized at the margins and central base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity 'anchor' region at the fluke base extending into the median notch. Notable high-contrast blobs include a vertical crescent-shaped mark on the mid-left lobe, a distinct circular spot on the lower-right-central lobe, and a smaller circular spot on the upper-left-central lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated acute angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire boundary; small pixel-amplitude jagged peaks (approximately 3-7 pixels in height) are present from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to both the left and right lobes, tapering towards pointed, dark-pigmented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple dark circular pixel clusters on the high-intensity white background: one prominent on the lower-right lobe, one on the upper-left lobe, and a constellation of smaller points near the left fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent curved vertical linear disruption (rake mark) located on the mid-left lobe; faint horizontal linear marks visible near the upper margin of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct crescent-shaped scar or pigmentation mark on the mid-left lobe; irregular dark trailing edge fringe indicating wear or minor trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge exhibits a continuous jagged dark border that provides a sharp pixel-contrast boundary against the water background.
